name: US-Japan Rate Differentials & USD/JPY
description: Analyzes how US-Japan interest rate differentials (10Y yield spread and policy rate spread) have historically driven USD/JPY over the past decade. Includes z-score normalized overlay charts, rolling correlations, scatter analysis with regression, and summary statistics.
source:
# =============================================================================
# US-JAPAN RATE DIFFERENTIALS & USD/JPY
# =============================================================================
# Question: How have US-Japan rate differentials driven USD/JPY?
#
# Data:
#   - USD/JPY (daily via market_data_source)
#   - US 10Y Treasury (DGS10, daily)
#   - Japan 10Y Gov Bond (IRLTLT01JPM156N, monthly → ffill to daily)
#   - Fed Funds Rate (DFF, daily)
#   - BOJ Policy Rate (IRSTCI01JPM156N, monthly → ffill to daily)
#
# Derived:
#   - 10Y Yield Spread = US 10Y − Japan 10Y
#   - Policy Rate Spread = Fed Funds − BOJ Rate
#
# Charts:
#   1. Z-scored overlay: USD/JPY + 10Y Yield Spread (co-movement)
#   2. Z-scored overlay: USD/JPY + Policy Rate Spread (co-movement)
#   3. Scatter: 10Y Yield Spread vs USD/JPY with trend line
# Table:
#   4. Summary stats: correlations, current levels
# =============================================================================

# ============================================================================
# DATA SOURCES
# ============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
usdjpy = src.c

# US 10Y Treasury Yield (daily)
us10y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DGS10', use_alfred=False)()
us10y = ffill(us10y_raw.result)

# Japan 10Y Government Bond Yield (monthly, ffill to daily)
jp10y_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRLTLT01JPM156N', use_alfred=False)()
jp10y = ffill(jp10y_raw.result)

# Fed Funds Effective Rate (daily)
fed_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DFF', use_alfred=False)()
fed_rate = ffill(fed_raw.result)

# BOJ Policy Rate (monthly, ffill to daily)
boj_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01JPM156N', use_alfred=False)()
boj_rate = ffill(boj_raw.result)

# ============================================================================
# DERIVED SPREADS
# ============================================================================

yield_spread_10y = us10y - jp10y
policy_spread = fed_rate - boj_rate

# ============================================================================
# Z-SCORE NORMALIZATION (252-day rolling for overlay comparison)
# ============================================================================
# Since USD/JPY (~100-155) and yield spreads (~1-4%) are on different scales,
# z-scoring normalizes both to standard deviations for visual co-movement.

usdjpy_z = zscore(window=252)(usdjpy)
yield_spread_z = zscore(window=252)(yield_spread_10y)
policy_spread_z = zscore(window=252)(policy_spread)

# ============================================================================
# ROLLING CORRELATION (60-day)
# ============================================================================
# Correlation between daily USD/JPY returns and daily changes in 10Y spread

daily_ret_usdjpy = returns(period=1, type=ReturnsType.simple)(usdjpy)
spread_change = yield_spread_10y - (yield_spread_10y >> 1)

corr_60d = rolling_corr(window=60, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=daily_ret_usdjpy, y=spread_change)

# ============================================================================
# FULL-PERIOD CORRELATIONS (expanding window for summary)
# ============================================================================

corr_usdjpy_yield = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=usdjpy, y=yield_spread_10y)
corr_usdjpy_policy = rolling_corr(window=60, window_type=WindowType.expanding, method=CorrelationMethod.pearson)(x=usdjpy, y=policy_spread)

bar_ts = index()

# ============================================================================
# REPORTS
# ============================================================================

# Chart 1: Z-scored USD/JPY vs 10Y Yield Spread overlay
xy_lines(
    title='USD/JPY vs 10Y Yield Spread (Z-Score Normalized)',
    category='1. Rate Differential Co-Movement',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score (Std Deviations)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Mean')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='USD/JPY', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='10Y Yield Spread (US−JP)', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_ts, usdjpy_z, yield_spread_z)

# Chart 2: Z-scored USD/JPY vs Policy Rate Spread overlay
xy_lines(
    title='USD/JPY vs Policy Rate Spread (Z-Score Normalized)',
    category='1. Rate Differential Co-Movement',
    y_axis_label='Z-Score (Std Deviations)',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Mean')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='USD/JPY', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Policy Rate Spread (Fed−BOJ)', color=Color.Teal, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_ts, usdjpy_z, policy_spread_z)

# Chart 3: 60-Day Rolling Correlation (USD/JPY returns vs yield spread changes)
xy_lines(
    title='Rolling 60-Day Correlation: USD/JPY Returns vs Yield Spread Changes',
    category='2. Correlation Dynamics',
    y_axis_label='Pearson Correlation',
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=0.5, color=Color.Emerald, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='+0.5'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.5, color=Color.Rose, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='−0.5')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='60d Correlation', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    area=True,
    order=0
)(bar_ts, corr_60d)

# Chart 4: Scatter — 10Y Yield Spread vs USD/JPY Level
xy_scatter(
    title='10Y Yield Spread vs USD/JPY Level',
    category='2. Correlation Dynamics',
    x_axis_label='10Y Yield Spread (US − Japan, %)',
    y_axis_label='USD/JPY',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    show_trend_line=True,
    series=ScatterSeriesSchema(series=[
        ScatterSeriesSpec(name='Daily Observations', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    order=1
)(yield_spread_10y, usdjpy)

# Summary Table: Key statistics
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Rate Differential Summary',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['Levels', 'Correlations'],
        col_headers=['USD/JPY', '10Y Spread', 'Policy Spread', 'Full-Period Corr'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, title='USD/JPY'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, title='10Y Spread'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, title='Policy Spread'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, title='60d Corr'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, title='vs 10Y Spread'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, title='vs Policy Spread'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, title='Avg 60d Corr'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3, title='Median 60d Corr')
        ]
    ),
    category='3. Summary Statistics',
    order=0
)(usdjpy, yield_spread_10y, policy_spread, corr_60d, corr_usdjpy_yield, corr_usdjpy_policy, corr_60d, corr_60d)
